'''Apollo South Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bgindependentmedia.org/residents-on-pipeline-route-for-data-center-worry-about-safety-property-values-and-lack-of-transparency/|title=bgindependentmedia.org|website=bgindependentmedia.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Rover Pipeline interconnect, southern Wood County, Ohio to Apollo Power Generation Facility, Middleton Township, near Bowling Green, Ohio.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bgindependentmedia.org/residents-on-pipeline-route-for-data-center-worry-about-safety-property-values-and-lack-of-transparency/|title=bgindependentmedia.org|website=bgindependentmedia.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
